description: This file contains functions related to fixing and updating metadata headers of a specific type (WRGG) stored in MTD flash devices, including checksum verification and repair operations.

methods.name: uint32_t le32_to_cpu(uint8_t * buf)
methods.description: Converts a 4-byte little-endian buffer to a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: int wrgg_fix_md5(struct wrgg03_header * shdr,int fd,size_t data_offset,size_t data_size)
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the MD5 checksum in a WRGG header within a device image, ensuring data integrity.

methods.name: int mtd_fixwrgg(const char * mtd,size_t offset,size_t data_size)
methods.description: Main function to locate, verify, and repair a WRGG header on an MTD device at a specified offset.

ctags.name: wrgg_fix_md5
ctags.pattern: /^wrgg_fix_md5(struct wrgg03_header *shdr, int fd, size_t data_offset, size_t data_size)$/
